# PercentBox

> Free online percentage calculator for everyday math: percent of a number, reverse percentages, increase/decrease, percentage change, tips, and discounts.

Site: https://percentbox.com
Language: en

## Main pages

- [Home / Percentage Calculator](https://percentbox.com/): Multi-mode free percentage calculator
- [What is X% of Y?](https://percentbox.com/what-is-x-percent-of-y): Percentage of a number
- [X is what % of Y?](https://percentbox.com/x-is-what-percent-of-y): Reverse percentage
- [Percentage Increase](https://percentbox.com/percentage-increase-calculator): Raise a value by a percent
- [Percentage Decrease](https://percentbox.com/percentage-decrease-calculator): Lower a value by a percent
- [Percentage Change](https://percentbox.com/percentage-change-calculator): Change from A to B
- [Tip Calculator](https://percentbox.com/tip-calculator): Tip, total, and split bill
- [Discount Calculator](https://percentbox.com/discount-calculator): Sale price and savings
- [Markup / Margin](https://percentbox.com/markup-calculator): Cost, sell, markup %, margin %
- [VAT Calculator](https://percentbox.com/vat-calculator): Add or extract sales tax / VAT
- [Compound Interest](https://percentbox.com/compound-interest-calculator): Growth with contributions
- [Loan / EMI](https://percentbox.com/loan-calculator): Fixed-rate payment + amortization
- [About](https://percentbox.com/about): About PercentBox
- [Privacy](https://percentbox.com/privacy): Privacy policy

## Formulas

- X% of Y = (X ÷ 100) × Y
- X is what % of Y = (X ÷ Y) × 100
- % change A→B = ((B − A) ÷ |A|) × 100
- After increase = value × (1 + p/100)
- After decrease = value × (1 − p/100)
- Tip = bill × (tip% ÷ 100); total = bill + tip
- Discount savings = price × (d% ÷ 100); final = price − savings
- Sell from markup = cost × (1 + markup%/100)
- Sell from margin = cost ÷ (1 − margin%/100)
- VAT gross = net × (1 + rate/100); net = gross ÷ (1 + rate/100)
- Compound FV = P(1+r/n)^(nt) + PMT×[((1+r/n)^(nt)−1)/(r/n)]
- Loan payment M = P×r(1+r)^n/((1+r)^n−1) with r = annual/12
